card.name: Word-start letters R in drug names
card.fires_on: Mostly a lone capital or lowercase R (or REM) that begins a word after a break, such as Ringer's, rilpivirine, RSV, RETHYMIC, or riel. It also fires on a few unrelated words like 'my'.

modes.label: R starting a drug or fluid name
modes.description: The letter R opens a split-up name such as Ringer's or rilpivirine.
modes.example: information for CABENUVA (cabotegravir extended-release injectable suspension;<< r>>ilpivirine extended-release inject

modes.label: R starting other terms
modes.description: A lone R begins an abbreviation or brand name like RSV or RETHYMIC.
modes.example: ivizumab for the<< R>>SV season. BEYFORTUS

modes.label: Currency or running text
modes.description: An R begins a split word in ordinary prose, such as riel or raged.

card.writes: Little clear meaning; it weakly favors 'hang' words and disfavors 'plate' words, which looks unrelated to the text.
card.plain: It lights up when a word starts with a stray R, most often in drug names like Ringer's or rilpivirine.
